test: a turn with no activated lore drops previous references and a later activation restores them
reason: Exercises activation, generation-start clearing, reactivation and dry-run retention through the real scene builder; prevents stale offstage card references leaking into later turns. Removed heading wording assertion while keeping actor/readings and lifecycle checks.

test: automatic profiles are opt-in and require an open chat
reason: Checks the disabled default and closed-chat gate prevent requests, avoiding unsolicited generation and writes outside a chat.

test: new admitted NPCs generate once; aliases, existing cards and the player are skipped
reason: Exercises alias deduplication, admission/player exclusions, card reuse, and initial held-state copying; prevents duplicate or wrong-subject NPC profiles.

test: chat or reply changes during generation discard the profile and stop subsequent requests
renamed_to: invalidating an in-flight profile discards it and stops subsequent requests
reason: Invalidates the caller's freshness callback during generation and asserts no profile/lore writes or subsequent NPC requests. Renamed to avoid claiming actual chat/reply event wiring is tested.

test: manual profile edits take precedence while the lore writer is running
reason: Writes a manual appearance while generation is pending and verifies it survives, protecting user edits against asynchronous overwrites.

test: a changed System or template field selection discards the generated result
renamed_to: changing configured profile fields discards the generated result
reason: Changes the configured field signature during generation and checks profile/lore remain unwritten. Renamed because the fixture changes fields, not the active System.

test: an unusable reply leaves a retryable card and does not prevent the next NPC profile
reason: An empty first result leaves that card blank, reports failure, and allows the next profile to finish; guards batch liveness and recoverability.

test: automatic portraits follow the shared Fill setting after the profile is saved
reason: Checks portraits honor the shared opt-in, are saved into selection/gallery, and follow lore persistence; guards missing/unsolicited images and partial profile loss.

test: portrait failure preserves the profile and allows the next NPC to generate
reason: A portrait provider failure preserves the completed profile and permits the next NPC image, distinguishing image failure from overall profile failure.

test: a stale portrait result is not assigned and manual portrait selection takes precedence
reason: Invalidation prevents stale image selection and later requests; a concurrent manual selection remains selected while the generated image enters the gallery.

test: shipped Systems validate and remain independent editable copies
reason: Exercises each shipped factory result through strict definition validation and verifies editing a returned name cannot change the next copy. Removed fixed location/catalog choices that constrain legitimate starter redesigns; required a nonempty choice list so the loop cannot pass vacuously.

test: fantasy portraits include species alongside appearance and exclude background
reason: Uses the actual Fantasy profile configuration with the real image description function: ancestry and visible appearance enter portrait input while a secret background stays out. This integrates the shipped selection flags with portrait behavior without freezing prose formatting.

test: carried cast links supply their profiles from multiple books without activating unrelated entries or replacing selections
reason: Keeps linked profiles from separate books, native entry flags, the selected host book, and cloned key arrays intact while excluding unrelated entries; catches destructive lore injection and shared-object mutation in createCastLoreActivator.

test: native chat, global, character and persona entries are never duplicated or overridden
reason: Checks the present-entry identity guard against all four host lore scopes with numeric/string UID equivalence; catches duplicate activation or overriding a disabled native entry before loading books.

test: generated profiles use the same activation path as carried profiles; repeated scans do not duplicate entries
reason: Removes an indistinguishable activation case: rosterSourceId is not read by createCastLoreActivator, so clearing it exercises the same linked-book path as case 1; repeat activation exercises the same present-entry deduplication already checked in case 2.
covered_by: tests/cast-lore.mjs: carried cast links supply their profiles from multiple books; native chat/global/character/persona entries are never duplicated or overridden

test: missing lorebooks and deleted entries leave normal host lore intact
reason: Deleted UIDs and a rejected book load produce no extra host lore and report the load error; catches missing-book failures wiping or corrupting existing lore.

test: extension, closed chat and System boundaries prevent activation
reason: Disabled extension, a mismatched selected System, and an absent open chat all return before loading books; protects against leaking a cast profile into an unrelated context.

test: chat or System switches, disablement, scope exclusions and changed links during loading cannot inject stale lore
reason: Deferred book loads are resolved after metadata/chat/System/enablement/card/link changes; checks both the current-context guard and recomputed wanted links prevent stale lore injection.

test: memory carryover works with automatic reading and roster reuse off
reason: Exports and imports active plus archived NPC memories with automatic capture disabled, strips old reply provenance, and verifies imported edits cannot mutate the exported record; protects portable knowledge independently of automatic reading.

test: new files carry memories regardless of memory reuse; older files keep their prior rule
reason: Exercises the distinct version-3 always-transfer branch and older version-2 carryOver gate, including replacing prior destination memories with an empty source; preserves readable historical files without silently retaining unrelated knowledge.

test: reusable cards cannot borrow a same-name active chat actor memory
reason: A reusable world card shares a name with an active chat actor containing different memories; serialization must use the card knowledge rather than borrow another adventure’s memory.

test: character transfer carries the visible Cast collections and memories, but only opted-in stats
reason: Actual serialization uses live chat stats/collections instead of stale card copies, excludes noncarryover HP, restores destination defaults, and keeps source state intact; catches incomplete or destructive character transfer.

test: portrait gallery, tags, selection and expression reference survive image remapping
renamed_to: portrait gallery, tags and selection survive remapping, and the expression reference is exported by index
reason: Checks capture and restore of two portrait images, selected image index, and remapped tag keys; capture also exports the expression-reference index. Renamed the test because it never invokes the wrapper that restores the expression generation reference itself.

test: sprite import creates a fresh pack and preserves variant filenames
reason: Imports two expression variants through multipart uploads into a newly generated folder and marks the binding unverified; catches pack overwrite or loss of the second same-emotion filename.

test: sprite export embeds every saved expression variant
reason: Loads both sprite paths, including cache query strings, and verifies both variant filenames survive embedding; catches export collapsing multiple variants of one emotion.

test: two chats can resolve the same speaker to independent local cards
reason: Local same-name cards shadow reusable world cards independently in two chats without modifying the shared list; protects chat-owned identities from cross-chat substitution.

test: a fresh chat profile cannot silently adopt a same-name lore entry
reason: Checks the autoLinkLorebook opt-out and explicit force override on fresh cards; prevents a new chat character silently adopting a prior adventure’s same-name lore.

test: world export includes independent NPCs from every assigned chat
reason: Collects same-ID NPCs from two distinct chat sources while filtering another System; checks chat identity participates in export deduplication so one adventure does not erase another.

test: portrait references in closed chats remain protected
reason: Both selected portraits and gallery images in closed-chat headers remain referenced; prevents global image cleanup deleting images still used by a saved chat.

test: fresh chat and persona values start at System defaults, without old global inventory
reason: Fresh chat seeds use System HP/inventory defaults instead of global persona values, while persona portrait/lore identity stays reusable and switching personas restores chat-local HP/items/memories; protects the core ownership split.

test: only a legacy tracker chat missing its player migrates old global values
reason: Removes a direct call repetition of migrateLegacyPlayer and createChatPlayerSeed. Its legacy inventory assertion now runs through the retained storage-loader integration, which already tests legacy HP versus fresh defaults.
covered_by: tests/chat-character-ownership.mjs: storage loads legacy tracker player from master, but fresh chats use defaults (now includes migrated/fresh inventory assertions)

test: storage loads legacy tracker player from master, but fresh chats use defaults
reason: Loads a legacy missing-player record through real storage binding, toggles location discovery without discarding the graph, then creates a fresh player and applies deferred roster map/memory seeds. Added legacy and fresh inventory checks here to retain the removed direct test’s unique assertion at the integration boundary.

test: an existing custom identifier moves to the top without changing stored field keys or values
reason: Reorders an existing custom primary field without replacing its object or changing item lookup keys, clears competing primary flags, and becomes idempotent; protects existing inventories when the editor normalizes schemas.

test: missing and duplicate Primary flags are repaired deterministically and normalization is idempotent
reason: Empty, missing-primary, named-primary preference, and duplicate-primary inputs normalize to exactly one identifier and remain stable on a second pass; protects imported collection usability.

test: identifiers are always static, including imported personal identifiers of every type
reason: Imported text/numeric/boolean identifiers must remain static, while nonprimary holder-specific fields retain their policy; catches an identifier becoming mutable or numeric nonprimary fields becoming library-owned.

test: reorder and delete operations cannot replace the identifier, even after every other field is removed
reason: Editor reorder/delete operations cannot move or delete the primary field, including after all secondary fields are removed; protects item identity through destructive schema editing.

test: reader changes use the pinned custom identifier instead of assuming a name field
reason: Passes a normalized, reordered custom string identifier into production add/update handling; catches the runtime assuming name even though the schema selected a different primary field.

test: numeric collection ranges survive System export/import and text choices remain intact
renamed_to: numeric collection ranges and text choices survive normalization and JSON round trips
reason: Checks optional numeric bounds, quantity minimums, removal of numeric options, retention of text choices, and idempotence across JSON serialization. Renamed to normalization/JSON round trips because the test does not call the actual System exporter/importer.

test: collection additions, replacements, defaults and updates respect optional numeric ranges
reason: Production add/update/replace paths apply decimal minimums/maximums and constrained defaults while retaining an unbounded numeric field; catches one collection write path bypassing type/bound normalization.

test: replacement preview never creates Item Library stores and acceptance writes only static fields
reason: For both absent and empty Item Library stores, replacement preview cannot allocate/write/save shared settings, but acceptance stores only static fields; catches previews committing changes or saving holder-specific uses globally.

test: preview reads shared static fields without overwriting them or holder-specific values
reason: Preview merges an existing shared description over a proposed rewrite while preserving personal uses and leaving settings/saves untouched; covers the existing-library branch that the missing-library case does not.

test: dry-run direct additions cannot clear committed tombstones
reason: Direct addItem preview must retain a committed deletion tombstone, while real acceptance clears it; catches a preview resurrecting an explicitly deleted item.

test: counted collections generate built-in quantity, pin the option, and reject conflicting defaults
reason: Staged generation injects built-in quantity into a counted collection, pins trackQuantity in the request schema, and rejects conflicting quantity defaults; protects generated Systems from incompatible item arithmetic.

test: gains accumulate equal amounts, default to one, and consumption removes only the spent quantity
reason: Repeated equal gains accumulate, omitted gain/removal quantities mean one, partial consumption retains other fields, and zero holdings removes the entry; checks counted inventory arithmetic rather than frozen example prose.

test: whole-stack removal is explicit and overspending removes at zero
reason: Explicit all removal and overspending both empty a held stack without a negative remainder; covers two removal branches absent from ordinary partial consumption.

test: invalid quantities leave holdings intact and produce review diagnostics
reason: Invalid add/remove values include zero, negative, numeric strings, infinity and NaN. Strengthened assertions after each operation and drained each diagnostic, so an invalid add followed by an offsetting invalid removal cannot pass merely because the final quantity matches.

test: updates set absolute quantities alongside other fields, and replacements retain absolute quantities
reason: Absolute update sets a supplied quantity with other fields, and explicit replacement retains the supplied total; catches accidentally treating absolute edits as incremental gains.

test: absolute updates preserve omitted quantities and remove an entry at zero
reason: Case-insensitive absolute edits preserve an omitted quantity, zero removes the entry, and updating an unknown identifier cannot create it; covers partial-update and noncreation boundaries.

test: invalid absolute quantities leave holdings intact and produce diagnostics
reason: Negative/string/null/nonfinite absolute quantities reject the whole update, including a secondary condition rewrite, and produce a diagnostic; protects held records from partly applying invalid edits.

test: uncounted collections retain set membership semantics
reason: An uncounted collection deduplicates repeated abilities instead of accumulating copies, still supports secondary edits, and removes by identifier; protects set semantics when quantity tracking is off.

test: custom identifiers, legacy quantity keys and transfers keep quantities owned by each actor
reason: Custom string primary and legacy qty field work for both player and NPC while per-owner quantity changes remain independent and committed state stays untouched in dry run; protects actor-owned stacks.

test: quantity settings infer existing counted fields, preserve keys, and round-trip built-in defaults
reason: Older qty schemas infer tracking without renaming stored keys, newly counted schemas gain default quantity one, repeated normalization is stable, and uncounted schemas stay uncounted; protects import/default boundaries.

test: reader schema supports partial consumption, whole-stack removal, and absolute quantity edits
reason: Reader schema exposes typed partial quantity removals, all-stack flags, and absolute quantity edits while requiring the actual identifier; catches a model contract diverging from runtime collection arithmetic.

test: accepting a partial-consumption review writes the absolute remainder once
reason: Builds an accepted partial-consumption review as the absolute remainder then applies it once to held items; catches double subtraction between preview and acceptance.

test: reader normalization applies absolute remainders to production review holdings
reason: Runs absolute quantity readings through production normalization/effective state/holdings for distinct Fantasy and Dating collection configurations without mutating source state. Removed a third same-Dating-path item-name variant that added no behavior beyond the retained two configurations.

test: collection previews explain unknown IDs and target mismatches without changing actors
reason: Unknown collection IDs and a wrong NPC template both produce actor-specific preview diagnostics and leave collections unmodified; draining warnings clears them, preventing stale refusal notices on later reviews.

test: changed examples preserve configured field types
reason: Generated collection update examples retain configured secondary numeric, boolean and text types; protects machine-consumable examples from instructing a model to emit the wrong JSON types.

test: missing and blank identifiers are explained for additions, updates and replacements
reason: Missing, blank and null identifiers on add/update/replace are rejected with the configured primary field identified and no admitted records; protects inventory identity and understandable review diagnostics.

test: numeric identifiers including zero remain valid, and normal writes do not leak preview warnings
reason: Numeric identifier zero remains valid through add/update/remove, and ordinary writes do not leave preview warnings queued; covers a truthiness boundary distinct from nonblank string identifiers.

test: collection examples use the primary field type consistently for all operations
reason: Add/remove/update examples must use the same configured primary value and type. Replaced exact illustrative number/boolean/text placeholders with type checks plus cross-operation equality; arbitrary example wording is not the contract.

test: reward config preserves stable entry IDs through field renames and duplicate row IDs
reason: Normalizes duplicate schedule row IDs and stored field-ID keys, then renames the primary display key without losing reward content; protects authored rewards from schema renaming.

test: entry validation respects actual primary, defaults, types, options and ranges
reason: Validates strict numeric/boolean/text-choice inputs, applies typed defaults, excludes locked/retired fields, and does not mutate input; prevents invalid level rewards entering holdings.

test: scheduled rewards include every crossed threshold and avoid holdings and reading duplicates
reason: Crossed levels yield all eligible scheduled rows while suppressing duplicate names, invalid entries, held items and already-proposed rewards; protects against missing or duplicate grants.

test: guided intervals, disabled rewards and empty schedules grant only configured levels
reason: Guided intervals deduplicate levels, default to each level, and do not accidentally run scheduled/disabled/empty reward configurations; protects reward-mode separation.

test: targets overlap without multiplying grants and empty/retired collections do not apply
renamed_to: reward eligibility respects resolved templates, empty targets and retired collections
reason: Checks resolved-template, legacy single-target, empty-target and retired-collection eligibility. Renamed the test because its boolean predicate assertions do not themselves prove that overlapping targets avoid duplicate grant rows.

test: template collection targets survive normalization and never widen a missing template to all NPCs
reason: Template-only targets survive normalization and reject wrong/missing/deleted template actors while permitting scope-wide schema discovery; removed a presentation-label regex that froze prose rather than targeting behavior.

test: unnamed collection changes resolve using an established template or a valid new assignment
reason: Unnamed operations route to the one allowed player/template collection, respect an existing actor’s established template over a proposed switch, and discard ambiguous unassigned actors with a diagnostic; prevents misplaced inventory updates.

test: model adds, removals, updates and replacements cannot change another template’s collection
reason: Wrong-template NPC operations cannot add/remove/update/replace/clear retained holdings, while case-insensitive IDs work for an allowed actor; directly exercises the mutation boundary beyond the targeting predicate.

test: portrait prompts hide belongings retained from a previous template
reason: Image prompts omit belongings retained from a previously selected template for both NPC and player portrait modes; prevents obsolete inventory leaking into visual descriptions.

test: multiple targets include the player and humans, exclude Pokémon, and survive System export/import
reason: Multiple player/template targets survive JSON normalization and accept only matching scopes, including multiple NPC templates and broad NPC targeting; removed the exact joined human-readable label expectation.

test: empty selections stay disabled and older single targets migrate without widening
reason: Legacy all/player/NPC/single-template targets normalize without widening, invalid/duplicate targets are filtered, and an explicitly empty target list stays disabled even if the old target key says all.

test: shared collections accept updates for the player and humans while refusing Pokémon
reason: Production collection updates classify the named player separately from NPC templates and admit a shared player/human collection while rejecting a Pokémon; protects call-site scope selection, which predicate-only checks cannot.

test: assigned preset parameters retain conflicting YAML, substitute macros, and leave saved data unchanged
reason: customProfilePayload must retain the selected preset YAML and substitute its macros without mutating the saved profile/preset; otherwise readers silently use different model parameters.

test: empty fields remain explicit and missing fields do not inherit active connection parameters
reason: An explicitly empty custom body must remain present while absent fields remain absent; this distinguishes clearing an override from leaking the active connection configuration.

test: Additional Parameters are restricted to the Custom chat-completion source
reason: Non-Custom providers must receive no custom YAML/header overrides. The test covers explicit OpenAI/Claude and missing provider values through the production source validation adapter.

test: unassigned presets and absent preset fields produce no Additional Parameters
reason: An unassigned completion preset and a preset with no custom fields are different valid empty inputs; both must yield an empty override payload instead of borrowing defaults.

test: a missing assigned preset fails explicitly
reason: A selected but unavailable saved preset must fail visibly. Returning an empty payload would quietly run a different request configuration.

test: copies only Additional Parameters, leaving unrelated preset settings out of the request
reason: Only include/exclude body and header strings may be copied; top-level temperature, model and provider from the completion preset must not override the reader request.

test: lore forwards assigned preset parameters while retaining raw response and truncation handling
reason: The requestLore integration verifies selected-profile custom parameters, cancellation signal, raw response extraction and truncation flag together, without an unintended main-API fallback.

test: plain speaker lines work without a character card or Markdown
reason: dialogueLabels must discover a quoted plain-name speaker without requiring an existing card or Markdown; straight and curly quotes cover separate accepted delimiters.

test: only line-start name and quoted dialogue count as a speaker
reason: Inline name mentions, stat-like lines, Markdown labels and unfinished labels must not create speakers; split host text/quote nodes are explicitly allowed through quoteFollows.

test: a compact sprite selection survives chat serialization without storing image bytes
renamed_to: a sprite selection survives chat serialization without replacing other metadata
reason: Sprite selection round-trips through serialized chat extras, preserves unrelated metadata and suppresses identical rewrites. Removed the arbitrary 350-byte assertion, which never supplied image bytes to test rejection.

test: each NPC line keeps its own expression and late image results update its path
reason: Per-line/per-NPC sprite records must remain independent, and completing a later image for the same line must update its saved path rather than another speaker.

test: message edits, display edits, different speakers and swipes reject stale selections
reason: Changing raw text, display text, swipe, speaker or line index must invalidate the old portrait selection so edited/regenerated dialogue cannot display a stale expression.

test: selections travel with native swipe extras and do not overwrite other swipe fields
reason: Writing the active swipe must preserve native extra fields and the earlier swipe record; returning to the first swipe restores its original expression.

test: dialogue extraction excludes prose, actions, following speakers, and incomplete streams
reason: dialogueQuotes must exclude narration, action spans and following speaker lines, while rejecting unfinished quotations; otherwise the wrong text becomes dialogue speech.

test: accepted quotation styles and escaped quotes retain the text needed for narration filters
reason: The six accepted quotation pairs and escaped embedded quotes must preserve both spoken text and quoted source spans used to remove dialogue from narration.

test: speaker resolution follows highlight case sensitivity and anchored aliases
reason: cardForDialogueName must respect case settings and literal/anchored regex aliases; unknown and substring matches cannot silently bind another NPC voice.

test: same-name speakers resolve to their chat card and display renames retain identity
reason: Chat-local card ordering must take precedence over same-name reusable cards, and changing the display name must retain the same card ID.

test: revision identities separate chat, character, group, message, swipe, edits, and display text
reason: dialogueRevision must change for every ownership/source dimension used by caches: chat, native character/group, message index, swipe, raw text and display text. It does not test host UI rendering.

test: saved prompts normalize, round-trip with cards, and preserve custom instructions
reason: Custom expression overrides survive normalization/card round-trip, unknown emotions are dropped, and generated pack identities differ across portrait changes and NPCs; this protects saved edits and asset ownership.

test: variant selection reaches every supplied alternative and preserves the prompt prefix
reason: Injected deterministic choices must reach each supplied variant with or without a prompt prefix. This tests selection behavior without freezing the shipped artwork count.

test: old built-in prompts adopt variants and body language while custom prompts survive
reason: Known legacy default prompts must migrate to current defaults while custom variant slots survive; editing one normalized instance must not mutate later instances.

test: default prompt storage is sparse and resetting overrides removes them
reason: Defaults must stay out of persisted overrides, clearing a custom slot must reset it, and callers must receive copies of variant arrays so previews cannot change global defaults.

test: random variants share pending jobs and failure suppression; explicit retry draws again
reason: Equal variant-array contents must share pending and failed job identity; an explicit retry may edit again. This catches duplicate image requests specific to variant-based prompts.

test: expressions use a shared editing workflow independently of the host portrait workflow
reason: The expression workflow resolver must use the shared setting, allow a per-NPC override and handle an unset workflow. These values choose the actual image-edit backend workflow.

test: generation prepares current reference and preserves existing packs until the portrait changes
reason: Preparing a portrait reference must be idempotent, switch packs after a changed portrait and preserve an existing manually chosen pack on first binding.

test: NPCs without portraits leave bindings untouched and per-NPC automatic switches are removed
renamed_to: NPCs without portraits leave expression reference bindings empty
reason: Cards without a portrait must not invent a generation reference or pack folder. Removed redundant retired-switch checks and narrowed the title to the behavior actually asserted.

test: duplicate jobs share one edit, send the saved prompt unchanged, and reuse completed sprites
reason: Identical generation jobs must share an edit and reuse a saved sprite; explicit replacement must edit again, while the stored prompt/options reach the edit adapter intact.

test: stale and cancelled jobs never upload or start queued edits
reason: A job becoming stale after editing and a queued job being aborted must cause no uploads or second edit; otherwise obsolete portraits consume requests and overwrite current assets.

test: failures do not repeat automatically or block other emotions; explicit retry recovers
reason: Failed jobs must not retry on every automatic request; another workflow/emotion and explicit retry must still proceed. This differs from the variant-key-specific deduplication case.

test: cancelled pending jobs settle promptly and fresh retries run after the old edit completes
reason: Caller cancellation must settle promptly while the uncancellable edit retains queue ownership; retry starts after it completes, cleans both temporary sources and uploads only the fresh sprite.

test: manual replace work has its own cancellation and does not reuse automatic work
reason: Manual replacement must not share the automatic job cancellation owner. Cancelling a queued manual replacement leaves the automatic edit able to finish.

test: replace requests independently regenerate a pending missing-expression job
reason: A replacement requested while a missing-expression job is pending must perform its own edit instead of being satisfied by that first job or its newly created sprite.

test: upload failures still clean generated sources and preserve the upload error
reason: An upload error must still clean the generated source and propagate the upload error; otherwise temporary files leak and the visible failure is misleading.

test: source cleanup deletes only the exact unique Image Edit image path
reason: Only the exact unique Image Edit output path may reach image deletion. Traversal, URLs, query strings, portraits and non-unique manual filenames must never be deleted.

test: FIFO queue coalesces duplicate active and waiting readings and releases task listeners
reason: Asserts active and waiting duplicates share promises, only one request starts before release, order remains 0/1/2, and listeners are released. Catches duplicate awards and out-of-order state baselines.

test: waiting reading is discarded after edit changes its source
reason: Changes queued message text before drain; verifies the stale request never starts and its task listeners are released. Protects edited replies from old readings.

test: waiting reading is discarded after swipe changes its source
reason: Changes queued swipe_id without changing text; verifies the prior swipe reading is rejected before dispatch. Protects alternate replies with identical prose.

test: waiting reading is discarded after deletion changes its source
reason: Deletes a queued index so another message occupies it; verifies object/source mismatch blocks the request. Prevents applying readings to shifted history.

test: waiting reading is discarded after replacement changes its source
reason: Replaces a queued message object with an equal-looking copy; verifies object identity is part of freshness. Prevents results from attaching to replacement replies.

test: waiting reading is discarded after chat changes its source
reason: Replaces chatMetadata before drain; verifies queued work is rejected across chat ownership even when message text and index match.

test: waiting reading is discarded after persona changes its source
reason: Changes current persona while work waits; verifies a queued reading cannot use the former player sheet in the newly active persona.

test: waiting reading is discarded after System changes its source
reason: Changes activeSystem before drain; verifies the queued request is never run using a different ruleset from the captured submission.

test: forgetting regenerated/deleted indexes cancels affected waiting readings
reason: Calls forgetFrom(2) and verifies only the affected queued turn is cancelled while earlier turns complete. Protects regeneration/deletion index invalidation.

test: stop cancels pending readings and allows a fresh request
reason: Emits Stop with active and queued work; verifies both cancel, no queued request starts, and a fresh request still succeeds. Exercises the stop event path.

test: chat cancels pending readings and allows a fresh request
reason: Emits chat change with active and queued work; verifies both cancel and listeners clear before a fresh request succeeds. Exercises chat event wiring separately from Stop.

test: clear cancels pending readings and allows a fresh request
reason: Calls queue.clear directly; verifies active and queued tasks cancel and a later request runs. Covers reset callers that do not emit host cancellation events.

test: a rejected reading does not strand the next queued request
reason: Makes the active extractor reject and verifies the queued successor still runs and task listeners clear. Prevents a backend failure permanently wedging the queue.

test: reader status stays with the reply and survives a redraw
reason: Exercises running/done/clear states, persisted report saving, and swipe-specific retrieval. Catches reports disappearing on redraw or leaking onto another swipe.

test: review counts follow live rows after apply and reload while diagnostics survive
reason: Moves 106 rows from pending to applied, serializes the message, and includes reviewed memory counts. Verifies reports recompute live counts without dropping retained diagnostics.

test: late reader result cannot attach to a replacement message or swipe
reason: Finishes work after message replacement and after a swipe change; verifies no report is attached or saved. Protects asynchronous report ownership.

test: breakdown separates change types and actors, then follows review and reload
reason: Checks multi-actor and multi-kind aggregate counts before and after review/reload, including accepted memories without tracker rows. Keeps meaningful counting coverage despite string-form API outputs.

test: earned XP and level-ups are explicit, including configured field names
reason: Checks renamed XP/Level fields classify as progression and downward levels classify differently. Protects review diagnostics from claiming an ordinary stat change or an increase incorrectly.

test: initial NPC XP and Level are stats rather than progression, including saved review rows
reason: Exercises blank, absent, null and saved none baselines so NPC initialization is not reported as earned XP/level-ups, while existing numeric zero is recognized as an existing reading.

test: initialized pools report their maximum once while fixed ratings omit their bounds
reason: Only freezes optional maximum-detail wording and placement in the report; actual pool composition is covered by review tests and stat/max deduplication is already covered by the multi-kind breakdown case. Removed presentation-specific expectations.
covered_by: tests/extraction-report.mjs — breakdown separates change types and actors, then follows review and reload; tests/review-stats.mjs — review keeps the other half for a single acceptance and can explicitly remove a maximum

test: level reward value and pool maximum share a count and retain maximum growth details
reason: Freezes optional maximum-growth detail text and standalone reward summary formatting. Grant materialization and review tests protect the actual growth; the general breakdown case already counts a reward once. Removed low-impact report presentation coverage.
covered_by: tests/extraction-report.mjs — breakdown separates change types and actors, then follows review and reload; tests/level-grant-review.mjs — growth uses live depletion and records both pool halves with full provenance

test: field assignments overlap only for selectable actor combinations
reason: Actor-overlap detection separates player from NPC and disjoint templates while recognizing broad NPC overlap and ignoring empty assignments; prevents unrelated character field definitions from conflicting.

test: assignment and rename checks allow separate namesakes and reject overlapping ones
reason: Rename/assignment conflict checks use case-insensitive names or profile labels, ignore the same object and retired fields, and reject only actual actor overlap; protects valid separate namesakes and invalid shared names.

test: manual profile fill creates a named chat card and uses the portrait automatic preset
reason: Verifies trimmed identity, chat membership, Fill preset forwarding, callback invocation, and returned card. Relaxed exact redraw count because multiple valid refresh strategies exist.

test: tracker and portrait requests share a fill lock and stale controls reuse cards and aliases
reason: Concurrent case-insensitive names share one Fill operation and a subsequent alias reuses the saved card; prevents duplicate requests/cards from stale controls.

test: blank names do nothing and a failed fill releases its lock for retry
reason: Blank names make no calls; provider failure reports an error and releases the lock so retry completes on the same card.

test: automatic Fill draws missing portraits by default and keeps completed stages
reason: Checks completed lore/images are skipped and portrait opt-out is honored, avoiding redundant costly generation while keeping missing stages runnable.

test: expressions: regeneration survives the host's outgoing-reply deletion
reason: Expression event wiring permits exactly the host regeneration deletion, then completes the replacement even when its prose matches the old reply. Prevents regeneration silently skipping expressions.

test: expressions: only one matching regeneration deletion is allowed
reason: Expression event wiring rejects unexpected-length, second, and ordinary deletions instead of treating them as regeneration. Prevents stale expression work after unrelated history edits.

test: expressions: chat changes, edits, swipes and Stop still cancel a regeneration
reason: Expression completion remains cancelled after chat/edit/swipe/Stop events during regeneration. Covers four distinct invalidation listeners in the expression implementation.

test: expressions: deferred regenerated completions reject later deletions and replacement objects
reason: Expression deferred callback checks message identity/version again after generation-ended; deletion and same-text object replacement cannot authorize stale image work.

test: speech: regeneration survives the host's outgoing-reply deletion
reason: Speech event wiring permits the host regeneration deletion and speaks the replacement even with identical prose. This exercises separate production speech wiring, not the expression function.

test: speech: only one matching regeneration deletion is allowed
reason: Speech event wiring rejects extra or unrelated deletions rather than authorizing old narration. Keeps a separate speech-side deletion guard because production wiring is independent.

test: speech: chat changes, edits, swipes and Stop still cancel a regeneration
reason: Speech generation is cancelled by chat/edit/swipe/Stop events during regeneration. Prevents unintended playback after user navigation or cancellation.

test: speech: deferred regenerated completions reject later deletions and replacement objects
reason: Speech deferred completion rejects post-generation deletion or same-text replacement. Protects the time gap before scheduled automatic playback.

test: absolute schema keeps XP and stat readings as strings while collection quantities stay numeric
reason: Checks production-built schema treats all player readings and XP as strings, quantities as numbers, and excludes model-authored Level/delta fields; prevents incompatible model output contracts.

test: absolute readings replace values rather than being added to held readings

test: optional exact name skips candidate generation and preserves spelling and punctuation

test: previously tracked named NPCs preserve assigned template, current stats and independent belongings
reason: Known tracker actors keep assigned template, current HP/Level/XP and independent holdings during card creation while missing configured stats initialize.

test: single-template and template-free Systems remain automatic without a required argument
reason: Single-template and template-free Systems work without a mandatory selector and expose appropriate automatic response/tool schema choices.

reason: Tool schemas follow active-System/template changes without mutating previously returned schemas; prevents stale or cross-request schema contamination.

test: known cards and tracker assignments cannot be retyped by creation

test: contract excludes player fields and validates the selected template
reason: Schema and validator exclude player profile fields, reject incomplete selected profiles, and reject unknown template IDs before persistence.

test: template choice limits both generated profile fields and stats

test: explicit settings without a System never inherit the live settings provider
reason: Explicit template-free settings ignore a live global provider and produce their own empty stat catalog, preserving caller/System isolation.

test: repeated and concurrent requests reuse the same saved card

reason: Persistent validation failure and connection failure leave no cards, stop at bounded attempts, and permit a later explicit retry.

test: lore failure returns the saved character and a recoverable warning

test: disabled creation and malformed tool arguments make no requests
reason: Disabled creation and malformed/unknown tool arguments make no model calls, enforcing the entry boundary before spending or writes.

test: a System without templates uses default NPC fields and no invented template

test: only the last dialogue line per NPC is classified, in message order

test: packs map labels and sparse fallbacks with stable variants independent of listing order

test: tracker cleanup before the deferred frame uses the final revision without accepting replacement messages

test: reset aborts a stalled request and fresh classification starts without its completion

test: deadline aborts stalled classification and releases subsequent jobs

test: caller cancellation releases the queue and suppresses late results
reason: An explicit caller abort must release the queue and prevent a backend result that arrives later from applying, independently of reset and timeout cancellation paths.

test: pending classification can adopt a completed line identity without another request

test: Dating Sim numeric relationship readings become saved strings without a repair request
reason: Finite numeric relationship outputs pass through real service creation as persisted strings with no unnecessary repair and without mutating the raw reply.

test: NPC generation shares reader recovery for fences, trailing commas, bare keys and swapped closers
reason: NPC validation accepts reader-style fences, trailing commas, bare keys and swapped closers while preserving recovered clothing; verifies parser wiring into NPC generation.

test: recovery still rejects missing fields, structured stat values and out-of-range numbers
reason: Recovery cannot bypass missing-profile, structured/invalid/out-of-range stat, malformed prose or response-size validation; guards permissive parsing corrupting state.

test: model definitions retain meanings and constraints without serializing editor metadata or empty inputs
reason: Checks configured profile/stat meanings, bounds, typed collection guidance and metadata omission reach model input; injects guidance and relaxes preset prose/format snapshots.

test: initial pool capacity limits and progression field names survive concise formatting
reason: Retains checks that initial capacity, configured Level/XP names and XP threshold reach generation and finite numeric Level normalizes; relaxes instruction sentence formatting.

test: collection defaults are offered for initialization without entering ordinary reader definitions
reason: Collection defaults are exposed only for initialization, while ordinary reader definitions retain identifiers, purpose, field types and bounds.

test: NPC memories stay chat local after scene departure
reason: Reads scene memories, writes chat map, removes scene actor and confirms retained chat memory plus independent fresh-chat card fallback; prevents scene departure losing memories or cross-chat leakage.

test: stable card ID wins over name after rename
reason: Writes memory under numeric stable card ID then renames card and retrieves it; prevents renamed NPC losing memory or accidentally resolving by display name.

test: reply removal selects NPC lore whose memory section must be cleared
reason: Compares pre/post reply memory removal and checks affected card is selected for lore clearing while unchanged store yields no card; prevents obsolete memory lore surviving reply replacement.

test: initials are distinct and prefer unused cast initials with accent normalization
reason: Keeps distinct candidate count, input immutability, and exclusion of accent-normalized used initials; removes exact chosen-letter snapshot tied to selection order.

test: scarce or exhausted unused initials fall back without repeating a letter
reason: Keeps scarce unused-letter inclusion, uniqueness, and valid fallback after alphabet exhaustion; removes exact fallback ordering that is incidental to the behavior.

test: the generated prompt supplies naming preferences and story context
reason: Checks requested naming culture/story are forwarded, bookkeeping names omitted, and used initials excluded; adds a nonempty candidate count so every() cannot pass vacuously.

test: fixed names bypass every naming and creative random draw
reason: Exact-name prompt construction never draws randomness and omits naming candidates/brief, preventing fixed identities being altered by creative naming.

test: at most four candidates are accepted, and a single usable candidate needs no repair
reason: Accepts one usable non-Latin candidate despite duplicate alternatives, rejects excessive candidates, and succeeds without repair; guards validation limits and cultural flexibility.

test: an exhausted candidate list gets one repair with the same naming brief
reason: An exhausted naming response receives one repair retaining the original request/brief and succeeds; distinct from general malformed-JSON repair.

test: generator context includes creative inputs and relevant state while leaving bookkeeping to code
reason: Generation includes requested creative context and only configured known-actor stats/collections, excludes unrelated prior cast/bookkeeping, and leaves caller context unchanged.

test: old and malformed preferences gain independent expression defaults
reason: Missing/malformed preferences must normalize to safe independent defaults, including separate nested prompt stores. Legacy automatic-expression flags are dropped instead of unexpectedly enabling work.

reason: Sprite folder validation must accept supported nested pack names but reject traversal, absolute paths, URLs, invalid depth, query/control characters and Windows paths before assets are requested.

test: narrator fallbacks use narrator model for cardless, default and undescribed dialogue

test: expression preparation runs alongside speech and fails independently

test: regeneration removes rendered speakers without a reader

test: legacy strings receive stable IDs and manual provenance
reason: Normalizes legacy strings into unique nonempty stable IDs/manual entries without input mutation, then checks normalization idempotence; removed incidental memory-1/memory-2 ID format expectation.

test: sourced turns dedupe regeneration and archive oldest entries
reason: Checks text/field dedupe across repeated/new turns and active/archive stores, with capacity-driven oldest-first archiving; prevents duplicate memories and overflow loss.

test: archived memories can be corrected and removed without changing source data

test: canonical config migrates old candidates, validates growth, and respects field IDs
reason: Asserts legacy growth candidates normalize to canonical IDs, renamed fields keep selection, counter IDs are excluded, and retired increments are dropped; protects usable progression after import/editing.

test: NPC templates opt in independently and only select owned fields

test: XP below the cap leaves level alone
reason: Asserts an absolute XP total below threshold preserves Level and stores the supplied total; protects the no-level-up branch of the core arithmetic.

test: reaching the cap levels up and resets XP
